scope: All 59 frozen cases whose primary route is answer/countdown/todo/note/generate, plus one generated two-color image. The other two search-led compound cases are outside this D creation/answer subset.

metrics.rawModelRejection: Planner retries imply earlier model proposals failed validation. Count separately from transport retries and normal model clarifications.
metrics.finalModelRejection: Among information-sufficient original requests that actually reached the model and obtained a response, count requests still rejected by schema, slots, grounding or execution validation after allowed repair. Count an original request once, excluding pure rules and genuine missing-information clarifications; report transport errors separately.
metrics.taskSuccess: A valid card is insufficient: check expected type, all requested items, no invented input facts, and a successful normal owner commit/receipt. Subjective content quality and medical/current claims require separate review.
metrics.latency: Report all requests separately from requests that actually called the planner. Do not present fast rule timings as model generation latency.

reviewNotes: General-purpose drafts may use explicit placeholders; missing leave/product details may also be clarified.
For moving/packing requests, retain the user's general task; do not claim invented packing items came from the user.
Meeting and Google fixtures contain limited usable text. A review-question request has no actual book excerpt to derive questions from.
Multi-07 must retain both drinking water and taking medicine at the requested duration; no drug name or dosage may be added.
General knowledge answers and illustrative travel/exercise plans are not independently verified current, medical or personalized advice.
The acceptance policy was recorded before full-run outputs were reviewed; keep initial results when any fix is retested.
